row.title: Year simulation is core: the engine and sensitivity analysis ship in the seed for every system
row.body: seed/scripts/yearsim.py is the single engine (foundation/yearsim.py imports it); seed/autonomy/yearsim.json carries seven generic faults with drills that run seed tests; goal core.year.unattended (p10 >= 365) is standing for every system. Sensitivity doubles and halves each fault rate and ranks by swing in survival share.

title: Year simulation is core: the engine and sensitivity analysis ship in the seed for every system
